profile_text.body:
Microsoft, headquartered in Redmond, WA, is a public company founded in 1975 with a revenue of $331.839 billion as of June 30, 2026. The company describes its Power Automate product as a platform for automating workflows and business processes across apps, systems, and websites using AI, digital, and robotic process automation. According to the company's own account, it enables automation across "nearly unlimited systems, desktop apps, and websites."

Microsoft offers an extensive AI product portfolio including Microsoft Copilot embedded across Microsoft 365, Azure OpenAI Service providing OpenAI models in Azure regions with enterprise content filtering, and Azure Machine Learning as an MLOps platform with AutoML capabilities. Additional AI offerings include Power Automate AI for enterprise workflow automation with Copilot integration and data loss prevention features, Teams AI for meeting recaps and intelligent summaries, SharePoint AI for enterprise content access, Microsoft Designer for image generation, Clipchamp AI for video editing, and developer tools including AutoGen for multi-agent frameworks and the Microsoft Agent Framework for agent orchestration.

The company faces legal exposure through two lawsuits filed in U.S. District Court, S.D. New York: The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, and Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc. Microsoft has 96 legal matters tracked in Washington state. The company does not maintain an MCP server in the tracked registry.
